findings.location: <section class="lyrics"> — 4th stanza (original: "To all my weak complaints and cries / Thy mercy lent an ear, / Ere yet my feeble thoughts had learned, / To form themselves in prayer.")
findings.source_quote:
To all my weak complaints and cries
Thy mercy lent an ear,
Ere yet my feeble thoughts had learned,
To form themselves in prayer.
findings.suggested_fix:
Keep the meaning but improve Norwegian idiom. Suggested translation: «Til alle mine svake klager og rop
gav din miskunn øre,
Før mine svake tanker ennå hadde lært
å forme seg til bønn.»
findings.translation_quote:
Til alle mine svake klager og rop
Din miskunn gav sitt øre,
Før mine svake tanker ennå lærte
Å forme seg i bønn der.

findings.location: <section class="lyrics"> — 5th stanza (original: "Unnumbered comforts to my soul / Thy tender care bestowed, / Before my infant heart conceived / From Whom those comforts flowed.")
findings.source_quote:
Unnumbered comforts to my soul
Thy tender care bestowed,
Before my infant heart conceived
From Whom those comforts flowed.
findings.suggested_fix:
Current translation contains a mistranslation and an inexplicable word "nav." that distorts meaning. Replace with a faithful Norwegian rendering that preserves the original sense: «Utallige trøster gav din milde omsorg min sjel,
Før mitt spedbarnshjerte forsto
Fra hvem disse trøster strømmet.»
findings.translation_quote:
Telløse trøster for min sjel
Din milde omsorg gav,
Før mitt spedbarnshjerte forstod
Fra hvem de kom og nav.

findings.suggested_fix: Translate the source note into Norwegian (article text and metadata must be translated). Suggested translation: "*kilder: Wikipedia og hymnary.org"

findings.location: Paragraph that first names the hymn (second content paragraph): "Salmen «When All Thy Mercies O My God», skrevet i 1712..."
findings.source_quote: The hymn, "When All Thy Mercies O My God," written in 1712, has been published in 994 hymnals...
findings.suggested_fix: Either translate the hymn title in-line to Norwegian or present both English and Norwegian title. Suggested in-line form: «salmen «Når alle dine miskunner, min Gud» (originaltittel: "When All Thy Mercies O My God"), skrevet i 1712..."
findings.translation_quote: Salmen «When All Thy Mercies O My God», skrevet i 1712, er blitt utgitt i 994 salmebøker...

findings.location: Several places — awkward or non-idiomatic Norwegian and small typos (e.g., "Enslig" -> should be "Enslig" or better "Ugift")
findings.source_quote: Being single into his 40s, he had hopes of someday having a happy marriage.
findings.suggested_fix: Correct small typos and improve idiomatic Norwegian. E.g.: «Ugift inn i førtiårene hadde han håp om en dag å få et lykkelig ekteskap.»
findings.translation_quote: Enslig inn i førtiårene, hadde han håp om en dag å få et lykkelig ekteskap.
